My plot is small, only a little piece of land, and maize is what feeds my family. I will try to get the FISP coupon like other farmers here in Balaka so I can buy fertilizer cheap — one bag of NPK and one bag of urea for the planting and topdressing. I also put some manure from the goats because the soil is tired. I do most of the work myself with the hoe, and maybe I call one or two friends for ganyu when weeding time comes hard.
